contract.words: Find a way to bring in $12,000 of settled cash within 45 days. I can commit up to $2,500 of capital. I am open to any industry.

terms.proofCondition: First paid sale settled to the owner account

strategy.title: Resell white-label websites to local businesses with no website, sold by cold email, built by AgencyPlatform
strategy.why: 17% of US small businesses have no website (Clutch 2025); a supplier publishes a $99 white-label build in 3 business days; at $1,000 paid up front each sale nets ~$870, so 13 sales settle $12,619 inside 45 days on ~$1,960 of spend, within the $2,500 ceiling. Close rate and acceptance of the $1,000 price are unmeasured, so the plan is gated by a day-14 test that spends only $294 before proof.

alternatives.title: White-label local SEO retainers (AgencyPlatform, $119/mo)
alternatives.why: Monthly price only $300-$400 and at most two billing cycles fit in 45 days, so ~20 clients would be needed; resale price unestablished

alternatives.title: Subcontracted year-end bookkeeping catch-up
alternatives.why: Bench gives the catch-up free with an annual plan, undercutting a $1,320 flat fee; fulfiller not secured and cost $600 per deal; buying signal unrecorded

steps.label: Buy AgencyPlatform Gold membership (2 months) for wholesale website rates
Set up Instantly Growth (2 months) plus 3 sending domains/mailboxes; build list of Google Maps local service businesses with no website; send ~1,000 cold emails
Offer: up-to-10-page mobile website with on-page SEO, live in ~7 days, $1,000 paid in full up front by Stripe link
Owner takes a 1-hour call with each interested business and closes at $1,000
Validation gate on day 14: count paid orders against emails sent
AgencyPlatform builds each site (AI Growth, $99, 3 business days); Brain briefs and QA-checks
Collect $1,000 per site up front through Stripe; first payout 7-14 days after the first live payment, then rolling

answers.finding: Ledger front-loads pre-proof sales (3-4 from the first 1,000 vs the 2/1,000 threshold); restate the cash sequence at the threshold rate and show the last of 15 sales closing by ~day 35.
answers.resolution: Accepted. The threshold is 4 of the first 1,000 and the ledger books exactly 4 sales by day 14 (days 8, 10, 12, 14) and 11 from the remaining 2,750 emails on days 18-35; the last settles day 42.

answers.finding: Scale-up sends 6,500 emails from 3 mailboxes after day 15; mailbox count, warm-up and their cost are not in the ledger and could push spend toward the $2,500 cap.
answers.resolution: Accepted. Scale-up is now 2,750 emails over days 15-30 (~185/day) from 7 Google Workspace mailboxes bought and warmed from day 1 ($8.40 x 7 x 2 months = $117.60, s12) on 3 domains (~$45), all in the st2 ledger line.

answers.finding: SEND_A_MESSAGE is NOT_CONNECTED and DISCOVER_LOCAL_BUSINESSES UNREAD for the reach and offer steps.
answers.resolution: The reach step begins by connecting the Instantly workspace and mailboxes (st2, day 1-2) before any send; no sale depends on a channel that is not connected by then.

answers.finding: Price $1,000 is at the top of the only accepted range (UENI basic $300-$1,000; table $700-$1,800); correctly left to the test.
answers.resolution: Agreed; OFFER_AND_PRICE stays missing and is decided by the day-14 test.

answers.finding: MARKET_VOLUME condition
answers.resolution: The card has no buyerVolume value (research returned NO_SUPPORT) and Brain's basis applies to a single buyer; MARKET_VOLUME is treated as missing and measured.

Threshold 4 paid of 1,000 (0.4%) x 3,750 contacts = 15 sales; the ledger books exactly 4 by day 14 and 11 from the remaining 2,750 emails (2,750 x 0.4% = 11) on days 18-35; the last settles day 42 inside 45, with the first payout's 7-day wait applied to sale 1 (day 8 -> 15) and later payouts inside a week. MARKET_VOLUME is now treated as missing and measured: the list-building step must count 3,750 no-website local businesses with a published email by day 10, with a stop before any scale-up spend if it cannot. Fulfilment is a public supplier I verified (AgencyPlatform AI Growth, up to 10 pages, $99 wholesale, 3 business days, Gold rate), each build is bought after its buyer pays, and pre-proof spend is ~$210 plus buyer-funded builds. Sending capacity is now costed (7 mailboxes, ~185/day in scale-up, ~26 per mailbox per day). Price $1,000 (top of UENI's $300-$1,000 basic range) and conversion are left to the day-14 test, which is the right unknown for a CONDITIONAL plan.
findings: Arithmetic checks: $15,000 gross, $2,331.10 out, $12,668.90 net; 4-of-1,000 threshold carries 15 sales over 3,750 contacts.
Margin is thin: 14 sales net ~$11,800, so a single shortfall below the 0.4% rate misses the target; the stop/continue rule should be read strictly at 4 of 1,000.
Mailboxes are warmed from day 1 while the first 1,000 emails go out by day 12; that is a short warm-up, and sending volume in week 1-2 may lag.
Owner call time (15 h for 15 closes) counts only buyers who close; calls with non-buyers are unknown owner time (no owner-hour limit applies here).
Sending (SEND_A_MESSAGE) must be connected through the owner's Instantly workspace before day 2; nothing is sold before it is.
